note: Independent CURRENT-Core source rejudgment against RFC1994 Section4.1: authenticator transmits CHAP Challenge Code1. Complete TestCHAPResponseEmitsEvent runs actual runCHAPAuthPhase over a pipe and requires first protocol0xC223, Challenge Code, legal Value-Size and fresh wire Identifier/Value before sending the matching Response. Read runCHAPAuthPhase/sendCHAPChallenge/writeCHAPChallenge: first authenticator act calls the writer with CHAPCodeChallenge, declared1. Single-positive scope is justified for an authenticator invocation with no must-not-challenge input branch; other authentication methods are distinct protocols. Suppressing/changing the first Challenge fails the direct wire assertion, not a fake request receipt. The new direct HAND_WRITTEN Code cut is authored separately and requires another judge plus actual observation; this note does not judge that cut or claim a missing record was obtained.
